legacy-migration.name: Build the immutable Gemini v1 writer
legacy-migration.run:
git fetch --no-tags origin 7bb42c064a4e0aa26a17c821f8fe1c2e35d4175e
mkdir -p .local/legacy-source
git archive 7bb42c064a4e0aa26a17c821f8fe1c2e35d4175e | tar -x -C .local/legacy-source
cargo build --locked --manifest-path .local/legacy-source/Cargo.toml --target-dir target/legacy
